title: My First Time
grammar: Marking a first-time event with (életemben) először; feelings around a first experience
goal: I can mark an event as a first-time experience using először and életemben először.
I can distinguish a one-time first-time narration from a general már-experience.
I can describe my feelings before trying something new for the first time.
I can use four new words for first-time experiences.
